div.head: VI As 5
div.ab: Fifte: þæt man ne forlǽte náne ǽscan naðer ne be norðan mearce ne be suðan, ǽr ælc man hæbbe áne ráde geríden þe hors habbe; ⁊ se þe hors nabbe, wyrce þam hlaforde þe him fore ríde oððe gánge, oðð he ham cúme, buton man ǽr to rihte cuman mæge.

Quintum: ne intermittatur aliquod uestigium (ali[qu]a uestigatio) uel a septentrionali merca uel australi, priusquam omnis homo unam equitationem equitauerit, qui equum habeat; et qui equum non habeat, operetur domino qui equitabit pro eo uel pedes eat, donec ille domum redeat, si antea consequi non poterit.

Fifte: Þæt man ne forlǽte náne ǽscan naðer ne be norðan mearce ne be suðan, ǽr ælc man hæbbe áne ráde geríden þe hors habbe; ⁊ se þe hors nabbe, wyrce þam hlaforde þe him fore ríde oððe gánge, oð ðæt he ham cúme, buton man ǽr to rihte cuman mæge.

Fünftens: dass man keine Nachforschung fallen lasse, weder nördlich der Grenze noch südlich der Grenze, bevor jeder Mann, der ein Pferd besitzt, Einen Ritt geritten hat; und wer kein Pferd besitzt, arbeite für den Herrn, welcher an seiner Statt reitet oder geht, bis dieser heimkehrt, ausser wenn man [der Bestohlene schon] vorher zu seinem Rechte gelangen kann.

Fifthly: that no search be abandoned, either north of the boundary or south of the boundary, before every man who has a horse has ridden one ride; and whoever has no horse, let him work for the lord who rides or goes in his place until he comes home, unless one [the person robbed] can get his right before that.

Fifth: No quest shall be abandoned either on the northern or the southern boundary, until every man who has a horse has ridden out once. And he who has not a horse shall go on working for his lord, when the latter is proceeding on horseback or on foot in his stead, until he [the lord] comes home—unless justice has already been obtained.

Fifthly: that no search is to be abandoned either north of the boundary or south of it, until every man who has a horse has ridden out once; and he who has no horse is to work for the lord who rides or goes on foot instead of him, until he comes home, unless justice can be obtained earlier.

Toller Suppl. schreibt benorðan, besuðan richtiger als Ein Wort. Nicht ‘in die nördliche (südliche) Mark’. Ost und West bleiben nur Kürze halber fort; gemeint ist ‘überall’ wie 8, 3 on twa healfa

Toller Suppl. more correctly writes benorðan, besuðan as one word. Not ‘into the northern (southern) march’. East and west are omitted only for brevity; ‘everywhere’ is meant, as in 8, 3 on twa healfa
des Gildegebiets; Toller 673b II versteht auch ‘Bezirksgrenze’
of the guild’s territory; Toller 673b II also understands ‘boundary of the district’

Um auszudrücken, dass die Polizei mit dem äusserst möglichen Eifer geübt werde, fordert die Gilde, dass jeder Diebstahl unablässig verfolgt werde, müsste gleich jeder Berittene des Gildengebiets bemüht werden, bei einem der Spurfolge-Versuche mitzureiten: gewiss nur eine Theorie

To express that policing is to be carried out with the utmost possible zeal, the guild demands that every theft be pursued unremittingly, even if every mounted man in the guild’s territory had to be called on to ride along on one of the attempts at following the trail: surely only a theory
